name: 33442 · Deerfield Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33442 (Deerfield Bch) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33442 (Deerfield Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33442 (Deerfield Bch) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
